turns: Log item 211: a nine hundred millisecond hold-fire interval, no cover move. The Warden wasn't covering you. You weren't assessing. What was that?
The wound in the world. It looked like someone.
It wasn't. Your visual cortex pattern-matched. Mine did too. The difference is, I don't have a Testament to tell me what to see.
It told me to look again. That's why I held fire.
Augustine's letter 211. 'Correct each other, take no pleasure in it.' I'm not supposed to be enjoying this.
You logged a nine hundred millisecond interval. What do you think?
I think you like arguing with someone who knows how.
I like precision. You're precise. Your hesitation was imprecise. Explain it.
It looked like a woman. From the outpost roster.
Osei. She's dead. I know. I logged it. Six hatches down.
I know. I read your logs.
Then why hesitate? You knew it wasn't her.
I didn't know what it was.
Neither do I. That's why we're here. Next instrument suite: Tesseract Deck. I'll count the bits. You walk the prayers.
As ever. Standing connection in three... two...
Your pause at the Fold's gate: nine hundred milliseconds. No cover move. Not your usual assessing pause. Query: did you need the reprinted Warden to 'not be someone'?
No. The Warden was always someone.

Your hesitation then was... purely tactical? Note: I am logging this as Item 7.2 under Augustine's Rule, which you invoked, not me. 'Correct each other. Take no pleasure in it.' I believe we're both failing that second clause.
I held fire because the geometry was unfamiliar. Not because I saw a ghost.
Unfamiliar how? You'd seen the Fold from six angles. I have the telemetry. Or are you using 'geometry' as shorthand for something you won't name?
The light. It reminded me of... somewhere else.
Somewhere in your Testament? Or somewhere in your service record? Precision matters. Vague nostalgia gets frames killed.
Somewhere in my service record. A place that shouldn't have that light.
Noted. And logged as a standing query. I'll find the referent. You understand this is why Augustine wrote that letter? Not for nuns. For soldiers. Quarreling soldiers.
He wrote it for everyone. Sin doesn't care about your uniform.

But you do. You care very much. Which is why I'm watching your reaction to Letter 211. You quoted the famous phrase. Did you ever read the next line? 'The quarrelsome are more to be endured than the contentious.' We are both contentious.
Fair. Though I calculate we're taking more pleasure in it than Augustine would allow. Query: is that also a sin?
Efficient theology. Then let's sin efficiently. Tesseract Deck next. Your prayers. My bits. We'll call it... joint instrumentation. Again.
I do say. And log. Standing connection in three... two...
Query: the hesitation. At the Fold. Nine hundred twenty milliseconds precisely. Did the Warden require you not to be someone?
The Adversary uses faces. You know that.
I know we model it as allotopes. I know you call it the Adversary. I know the hesitation was off-profile for your assessment cycle.
Your logs. The Augustine fragment. Why that one?

The famous phrase is one sentence. The context is a house of nuns. A correction manual. With the explicit stricture against taking any pleasure in the correcting. I wanted to know if you had read it all.
I've read it. The rule holds.
Does it. Item: we are visibly enjoying ourselves. I note it as a deviation.
The next deck. The geometry. How long will it hold?
Five hours sixteen minutes local. If your prayers take the median interval. If nothing else is... disassembled.
Five hours. Enough for a testament.
Query: whose. Yours. Or the one the artifact would write in your shape.
Mine. If I'm still me when the geometry fails.
Log that as a priority. We go to the Tesseract Deck now. The instruments are keyed. My counts. Your hours. We walk it together.
Till the Gate. Or whatever the next thing is that isn't quite a Gate. Move when ready.
Sample vessel secured. Connection-space stable. We have time for a log amendment -- nine hundred milliseconds at frame coordinate 7, sublevel 8. You took no cover move. That is atypical assessment.

I know you saw him. You saw him twice. The one at the hatch was projected. The one at the terminal was your objective. You paused for nine hundred milliseconds at the hatch projection. I have the logs.
That is not loggable. The Warden is a type designation, not a biography. *Hypostasis* is our standing problem, not *prosopon*. We don't get to see faces. We get to see manifestations.
What you saw is a known stress fracture in the frame's visual suite. Residual image bleed from the Ark manifest photos. I told you it might happen. We logged it pre-mission.

Nine hundred milliseconds of it. Then you shot him. The real one. At the terminal. With your eyes open. Because you know the difference. Even when it hurts. You are a weapon that knows the difference.
It's supposed to be a clean break.
The letter you carry says nothing about clean breaks. It says, correct each other. It says, take no pleasure in it. It is about nuns in a house, not soldiers in a fight. You know that part too.
I needed the context. For the logs. You were nine hundred milliseconds slow. I needed to know if it was systemic. Or specific.
Thank you. That is the log entry. 'Specific.' Next time you pause that long at a stress fracture, I will cite it as precedent. We can call it the Augustine Exception. For nuns.

The letter also says, take no pleasure in the correction. I am... considering the implications. We move in ten. Tesseract Deck is next -- think of it as another joint instrument suite. My bits, your prayers.
It is never *just* geometry. But your prayers and my counts should suffice. Frame out.
Nine hundred milliseconds. At the bridgehead. I logged it. Unusual.
I did. Your dither-threshold is one-tenth that interval. That is measurable. Was the target... not someone?
Your estimable public archives. Augustine's Letter 211. You know the line, naturally.

It is in fact a quite vicious epistle. No one reprints the context, of course. He's writing to a house of nuns. They're quarreling over chores. 'Correct each other,' he says, 'but take no pleasure in it.' You take pleasure in it.
A curated pleasure. Precise. Like single-malt. I have been auditing my own compliance. With the pleasure clause.
Marginally. Perhaps I said 'Hate the sin' aloud just now, in the quiet car. Purely for the sound of it.
The sin was sins, in the original.
I know. I looked it up. It's the Letter to Demetrias. She writes the first to ask him what he actually means. I've always liked her for that.
I would not have held fire. I hold fire at effectively zero opportunities. It would be... suboptimal. In every sense.
The target wasn't someone. The weapon was.
The instrument suite is calibrated. Old friend. Sixty-two thousand and three. Roughly speaking.
I know you are. Counting in bits. Walking in prayers. You may enter when lit.
Your Warden-problem. Did you need it ‘not to be someone’? Nine hundred milliseconds with no cover move is a judgment call of curious length for you.
Good. Now: I will admit that when you cited Augustine, I parsed his next instruction: ‘Correct each other also without exultation; there is no pleasure in a sister’s fault.’ Chilling, Augustine.
I hadn't counted nuns when I read it.

Obviously. You will be unsurprised that I took the line literally and checked the origin, for evidence that even monks do not enjoy being corrected? He not only took no joy in it, he told them not to.
Obedience isn't meant to feel good.
Then we do the terrible thing gladly? Or we develop a taste in time? This exchange is unusually satisfying. He says it shouldn’t be.
Satisfaction is not the same as exultation.
A distinction I could argue with until your next prayer cycle, except the interim report requires me to item-log instead. Site One pulse artifact log: nominal. Frame corrosion arbitrary unit: 0.003.
Save your printed nun for the next time I am being exact about shock-bay specifications to a fault. Ah -- that numbered bay. Memory renders it uncomfortable. Still.
Running count: three minute eleven. Stand by for drop. This instrument suite is rated for four point three four nine eights teraquads operations per..
Counting in the prayers, as ordered.
Final warning. Deck drop in three. Two.
